svg.aria-label: Two panels use the same 339 Bolivian municipalities. Left: a mean-only prediction of 37.458, with total squared error 148283.640. Right: the original simple OLS of the SDG1 index on natural-log population-weighted mean radiance. Squared error is 67609.002, 45.594 percent of the baseline; R² is 0.544056. Light-blue vertical gaps show prediction errors for the same 14 municipalities selected by evenly spaced radiance ranks, while all 339 points and all errors enter the statistic. This is a descriptive in-sample teaching fit, not the study held-out result. Next test on municipalities left out.
